why: Pure careful string handling: step through the indices two at a time and swap each pair, leaving a trailing odd letter alone.
hints: Strings are immutable in Python. What would you work on instead?
Convert to a list and step i = 0, 2, 4, ... swapping positions i and i+1.
Stop the loop at len - 1 so an odd final letter is untouched, then join. O(n).
pitfalls: Odd length: the last letter stays put.
Looping to len instead of len - 1 indexes past the end.
